cats.d: Real fruit, mostly dairy-free. Start here on a hot day.
Lower sugar, cottage cheese, Greek yogurt and fruit-only swirls.
Protein shakes, powders and cottage cheese. Smooth, not chalky.
The classic cone swirls. Full-fat dairy gives the best texture.
Scoopable classics, plus a big menu of mix-in flavors.
Ready in minutes. Some need no freezing at all.
Cooked custards and gelato for showing off.

recipes.title: Store-bought soft serve
recipes.blurb: Turn any pint of plain ice cream into soft serve in about a minute. No freezing wait.
ing: 2 cups (1 pint) plain store-bought ice cream, gelato, sorbet or frozen yogurt (no chunks, swirls or cores)
steps: Scoop the pint into an empty Swirl pint, up to the MAX FILL line. Close the base first.
Press Soft Serve, then Re-Spin.
Snap on the swirl lid, then pull the handle to swirl into a cone or chilled bowl.
recipes.df: Use dairy-free ice cream, gelato or frozen yogurt.
recipes.lite: Use lite, low-calorie, keto or reduced-sugar ice cream.

recipes.title: Salted caramel pretzel milkshake
recipes.blurb: A thick shake in about a minute and a half, made with store-bought vanilla ice cream.
ing: 1/3 cup pretzels, broken, plus more for topping
steps: Put the ice cream in an empty pint (base closed).
Poke a 1 1/2-inch hole down to the bottom with a spoon.
Add the milk, caramel, pretzels and half the salt to the hole.
Press Scoop, then Milkshake.
Pour or spoon into a tall glass.
recipes.tip: Top with extra crushed pretzels and the rest of the salt.

recipes.title: Pantry one-pint ideas
recipes.blurb: No recipe needed. Pour or spoon these straight into the pint, freeze, and spin.
ing: Canned pineapple, mango, tropical fruit or mandarins: fill with fruit, top with the can juice. Spin Scoop, Sorbet or Soft Serve, Fruit Whip.
Pie filling (cherry, blueberry, lemon, strawberry, apple): fill to the line. Scoop, Sorbet or Soft Serve, Fruit Whip.
Applesauce: fill to the line. Scoop, Sorbet or Soft Serve, Fruit Whip.
Grapefruit cups: fill with fruit and top with the cup juice. Scoop, Sorbet or Soft Serve, Fruit Whip.
Eggnog: fill to the line. Scoop or Soft Serve, Lite Ice Cream.
Chocolate milk: fill to the line. Scoop, Lite Ice Cream.
Ready-made protein shake (14 oz): pour in. Scoop or Soft Serve, CreamiFit.
Flavored yogurt: fill to the line. Scoop or Soft Serve, Frozen Yogurt.
Coffee treat: 1/2 cup cooled brewed coffee plus 1 1/2 cups coffee creamer. Scoop or Soft Serve, Lite Ice Cream.
steps: Pour or spoon into the pint (base closed, below the MAX FILL line).
Freeze 24 hours, then spin with the program listed.
recipes.tip: Canned fruit packed in water doesn't work. Pick fruit in juice or light syrup.

recipes.title: Easy vanilla soft serve
recipes.blurb: The classic diner swirl. Start here.
steps: Whisk the sugar and pudding mix together in a big bowl.
Slowly add the milk, cream and vanilla. Whisk until the sugar is gone.
Pour into an empty pint (base closed).
Lid on. Freeze flat for 24 hours.
Press Soft Serve, then Ice Cream.
Snap on the swirl lid, then pull the handle to swirl into a cone or chilled bowl.
recipes.df: Use unsweetened oat milk for the whole milk and unsweetened coconut cream for the heavy cream.
recipes.lite: Use 2 tbsp agave nectar instead of the sugar, then spin on Soft Serve, Lite Ice Cream.

recipes.title: Protein flavor mix-and-match
recipes.blurb: Start with a vanilla or chocolate protein base, add a flavor, done.
recipes.program: Soft Serve or Scoop, then CreamiFit
ing: BASE: Vanilla = 1 ready-made vanilla protein shake (14 oz) or 1 3/4 cups low-fat milk/almond milk + 1 scoop vanilla protein powder.
BASE: Chocolate = 1 ready-made chocolate protein shake (14 oz) or 1 3/4 cups chocolate milk + 1 scoop chocolate protein powder.
Cookies & cream: vanilla + 1 tsp vanilla + 1 tbsp cookies & cream pudding mix. Top with 2 to 3 broken sandwich cookies.
Peanut butter cup: vanilla + 3 tbsp peanut butter powder + 1 tbsp chocolate pudding mix. Top with 2 tbsp mini peanut butter cups.
Mint chip: vanilla + 1/2 tsp peppermint extract + 1 tbsp vanilla pudding mix + 2 drops green coloring. Top with 1/4 cup mini chocolate chips.
Caramel macchiato: vanilla + 2 tbsp instant espresso + 1 tsp vanilla pudding mix + 1 tsp caramel extract. Top with toffee bits.
Birthday cake: vanilla + 1 tsp vanilla + 1 tbsp vanilla pudding mix. Top with 2 tbsp sprinkles.
Cinnamon roll: vanilla + 1 tsp vanilla + 1 tsp cinnamon + 1 tbsp vanilla pudding mix. Drizzle caramel.
Creamsicle: vanilla + 2 tsp orange zest + 1 tsp orange extract + 1 tbsp vanilla pudding mix.
Frosted lemonade: vanilla + 2 tsp lemon zest + 1 tsp lemon extract + 1 tbsp lemon pudding mix.
Horchata: vanilla + 1 tsp cinnamon + 1 tbsp vanilla pudding mix.
Chocolate peanut butter: chocolate + 3 tbsp peanut butter powder + 1 tbsp chocolate pudding mix.
Chocolate banana: chocolate + 1 tsp banana extract + 1 tbsp banana pudding mix.
Chocolate caramel brownie: chocolate + 1 tsp caramel extract + 1 tbsp chocolate pudding mix. Top with brownie pieces.
steps: Whisk the base with the flavor ingredients until smooth.
Pour into an empty pint (base closed).
Lid on. Freeze flat for 24 hours.
Press Soft Serve or Scoop, then CreamiFit.
Swirl it out, or scoop it.
recipes.tip: Mix-ins only work for scooped pints. For soft serve, put toppings on after swirling.

Take the pint out and scoop.

recipes.title: Ice cream flavor menu
recipes.blurb: Make the vanilla ice cream above, spin, then add one of these. Mix-ins only work for scooped pints.
ing: Chocolate chip cookie dough: 1/4 cup edible cookie dough chunks + 1 tbsp mini chocolate chips.
Cookies & cream: 3 broken chocolate sandwich cookies.
Rocky road: add 3 tbsp cocoa to the base. Mix in 2 tbsp chopped almonds, 2 tbsp mini chocolate chips, 1 tbsp marshmallow topping.
Mint chocolate chip: skip the vanilla, use 1/4 tsp peppermint extract (green coloring optional). Mix in 1/4 cup mini chocolate chips.
Maple walnut: skip the vanilla, use 1 tsp maple extract. Mix in 1/4 cup chopped walnuts.
Death by chocolate: add 3 tbsp cocoa to the base. Mix in 2 tbsp mini chocolate chips and 2 tbsp brownie chunks.
Pistachio: skip the vanilla, use 1/2 tsp almond extract. Mix in 1/4 cup chopped pistachios.
Sweet & salty: 1 tbsp mini pretzels, 1 tbsp broken potato chips, 1 tbsp broken chocolate candies.
Peppermint stick: skip the vanilla, use 1/4 tsp peppermint extract. Mix in 1/4 cup candy cane pieces.
Raspberry chip: skip the vanilla, use 1 tsp raspberry extract. Mix in 1/4 cup mini chocolate chips.
Rum raisin: skip the vanilla, use 1 tsp rum extract. Mix in 1/4 cup raisins soaked in hot water.
S'mores: add 3 tbsp cocoa to the base. Mix in 3 tbsp graham cracker pieces and 1 tbsp marshmallow topping.
Peanut butter cup: add 3 tbsp cocoa to the base. Mix in 1/4 cup broken mini peanut butter cups.
Caramel nut cluster: mix in 1/4 cup broken chocolate-covered caramels and 2 tbsp chopped cashews.
Chocolate toffee crunch: add 3 tbsp cocoa to the base. Mix in 1/4 cup broken toffee bar.
steps: Make the vanilla base from the recipe above and freeze.
Spin on Scoop, Ice Cream.
Poke a 1 1/2-inch hole to the bottom, add your mix-ins, and press Mix-In.
Lid on. Freeze flat for 24 hours.
Press Scoop, Ice Cream, then Mix-In.
Take the pint out and scoop.
recipes.tip: Skip fresh fruit, sauces and spreads as mix-ins. They water things down. Use frozen fruit or a topping after.

recipes.title: Cookies & cream frozen custard
recipes.blurb: Thick, rich and cookie-studded. Cooked on the stove.
ing: 1 vanilla bean (scraped) or 1 tsp vanilla extract
4 chocolate sandwich cookies, filling removed, crushed (plus more for topping)
steps: Whisk the egg yolks, corn syrup and sugar in a small saucepan.
Add the cream, milk, vanilla and the crushed cookies.
Cook on medium, stirring the whole time, until it reaches 165 to 175 degrees F.
Strain into an empty pint (base closed). Set the pint in an ice bath until cool.
Lid on. Freeze flat for 24 hours.
Press Soft Serve, then Frozen Custard.
Snap on the swirl lid, then pull the handle to swirl into a cone or chilled bowl.
recipes.df: Use unsweetened coconut cream and unsweetened oat milk.
recipes.tip: Keep the heat between 165 and 175 degrees F. Eggs need 165 to be safe, and too hot makes them scramble.

recipes.title: Cinnamon-sugar cereal frozen custard
recipes.blurb: Like the milk at the bottom of the cereal bowl.
recipes.prep: 5 min + 15 to 30 min soak + 10 min cook
steps: Stir the cream, milk and cereal in a bowl. Let it sit 15 to 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Whisk the yolks, corn syrup and sugar in a saucepan.
Strain the cereal milk into the saucepan (press the cereal, then toss it). Stir in the vanilla.
Cook on medium, stirring the whole time, until it reaches 165 to 175 degrees F.
Strain into an empty pint (base closed). Cool in an ice bath.
Lid on. Freeze flat for 24 hours.
Press Soft Serve, then Frozen Custard.
Snap on the swirl lid, then pull the handle to swirl into a cone or chilled bowl.
recipes.df: Use unsweetened coconut cream and unsweetened oat milk.
recipes.tip: Keep the heat between 165 and 175 degrees F. Eggs need 165 to be safe, and too hot makes them scramble.

Strain into an empty pint (base closed). Cool in an ice bath.
Lid on. Freeze flat for 24 hours.
Press Soft Serve, then Frozen Custard.

Add the cream and milk.

Off the heat, whisk in the chocolate chunks until melted.

Press Scoop, then Gelato.
Take the pint out and scoop.
